title: Blue-Green & Canary Deployment Pipelines
learningObjectives: Compare Blue-Green instant switch deployments with gradual Canary percentage rollouts
Automate automated rollback triggers on error rate or latency metric anomalies
Maintain backward-compatible database schemas across concurrent running versions
keyTradeoffs: Double infrastructure footprint cost during Blue-Green deployments vs Canary gradual risk exposure
Sticky canary sessions by user ID vs random percentage request routing
commonPitfalls: Deploying breaking database schema changes during a blue-green swap, crashing the live version
Failing to monitor canary metrics for subtle errors before rolling out to 100% of production
transferPrompt: How do automated canary deployment controllers evaluate SLO burn rates to trigger rollbacks?
